CNBC. LD datePublished = dateModified 15 Oct 04:48 BST. By Jenny Lee and Kate Rooney.
Headline: 'Anthropic's third-quarter revenue is said to hit $16.8 billion ahead of IPO'.
Anthropic told investors Q3 revenue stands at $16.8bn, ahead of an IPO 'reportedly slated for November', according to people familiar with the matter.
Revenue trajectory: Q1 $4.7bn, Q2 $11.6bn, Q3 $16.8bn. Anthropic said it was profitable on an adjusted basis in Q3 and cash-flow positive, generating $1.70 in revenue for every dollar spent on computing power in Q3.
SOURCING CAUTION - CNBC IS CITING OTHER OUTLETS FOR TWO FIGURES: the $1.70-per-dollar compute figure is attributed to the Financial Times; the expectation that Anthropic reaches $110bn annualised revenue by year-end is attributed to The Wall Street Journal. Both are blocked/unapproved for us - either drop those two figures or attribute them generically, and keep the $16.8bn/$11.6bn/$4.7bn line which CNBC has from its own sources.
CNBC previously reported the Claude maker planned to disclose Q3 results for the first time at a meeting with potential investors including institutional investors, citing two people familiar.
BBC carried the same story ('Anthropic flags revenue surge to investors ahead of stock market debut', BBC business RSS, Thu 08:20 BST per feed pubDate) - available as a second approved source if needed.
WHY IT MATTERS: pairs with the sell-off - investors are marking down AI infrastructure exposure on financing costs at the same moment the sector's biggest private name is showing a revenue surge into a November listing.
